paragraphs: National Center for Safety Initiatives, or NCSI, sells background screening and policy guidance to organizations working to create safer environments. The site frames that work as helping organizations minimize their liability and meet strict legal mandates.

Screening options include motor vehicle reports that review a driving record for license status, violations, and restrictions. Social media screening scours web results and social media networks for potential online red flags. Education and employment checks are offered to confirm what a candidate says about credentials and experience.

The page lists parks and recreation associations among the organizations served. Schools and education departments appear on that same list. Pricing is described as flat rate, and the stated rate includes all fees from local sources. Personally Identifiable Information is stored securely for data privacy and compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

quote.text: You’ll get access to easy-to-use online tools where you can quickly view and manage your background checks in one place.
